tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Free current prices, coverage and schemas.

tools.name: claim_worth_it
tools.description: $0.15 per successful call, prepaid. Confirmed claim amount, gas, net value, safety flags and action verdict. Includes free hashed evidence-receipt.

tools.name: collectible_quote
tools.description: $0.20 per successful call, prepaid. TRUE collectible amount per curve/escrow via unsigned simulated sweep; raw RPC overstates reality.

tools.name: launchpad_fee_audit
tools.description: $0.25 per successful call, prepaid. One-wallet scan across supported launchpads for unswept or unclaimed creator fees.

tools.name: agent_budget_guard
tools.description: $0.15 per successful call, prepaid. Deterministic read-only spend policy verdict for amount, destination, and approval ceiling. Caller supplies policy; unknown targets require review.

tools.name: allowance_risk_check
tools.description: $0.15 per successful call, prepaid. Live ERC-20 allowance, owner balance and spender-code check at one block; flags effectively unlimited approvals.

tools.name: tx_preflight
tools.description: $0.20 per successful call, prepaid. Unsigned EVM eth_call and gas estimate at a measured block; flags approvals and delegated target code. Never signs or broadcasts.

tools.name: x402_health_check
tools.description: $0.15 per successful call, prepaid. DNS-pinned public HTTPS probe of an x402 endpoint's 402 quote, price, network and recipient; no payment sent.

tools.name: dependency_report
tools.description: $0.25 per successful call, prepaid. Compare a live primary x402 quote with your saved baseline; detect price, network, asset, recipient and HTTP status changes. No payments sent; no uptime-history claim.

tools.name: launch_economics
tools.description: $0.15 per successful call, prepaid. Pons token-specific on-chain pool fee, creator share, initial buy, current deployer holdings and estimated launch-cost break-even volume.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_budget_guard · Private data: launchpad_fee_audit, launch_economics · Public sink: launch_economics.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_budget_guard · Private data: launchpad_fee_audit, launch_economics · Public sink: launch_economics

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
